title: Cancellation Charges on Entry & Patio Door Contracts Outside the Cooling-Off Right
content:
A cancellation of an Entry & Patio Door Contract that does not qualify for the cooling-off terms is settled by the contract status on the date the written notice is given.

## Clause 1: the charge by status

| Contract status on the notice date | Cancellation charge |
|---|---|
| Signed | The series pre-measure cancellation fee |
| Measured | The series measure-and-design charge |
| Ordered | The series product share of the adjusted contract value, rounded to the cent |
| Installed or closed | Cannot be cancelled |

The adjusted contract value is the signed contract price plus the net contract charges before the cancellation charge itself. The net contract charges are the change orders and fees added to the contract since signing, less the price credits granted against it.

## Clause 2: booking the charge

The charge is booked as one cancellation charge fee on the notice date.

## Clause 3: payments, refund and amount owed

Payments received, net of refunds already made, are kept up to the charge; the excess is refunded as a cancellation refund within the refund window, taken from the most recent payments first, each refund naming its source payment. When payments received are below the charge, the difference stays owed.

## Clause 4: after cancellation

Once a door contract is cancelled, no further change order, measure visit, or price credit other than an on-time guarantee credit already earned is booked to it.

## Worked figures (hypothetical contracts)

**Ordered contract, payments below the charge.** A Ridgeline Portal 640 Woodgrain Fiberglass Entry Door contract signed at $7000.00 carries change orders of $600.00 and a price credit of $100.00, so its net contract charges are $500.00 and its adjusted contract value is $7500.00. At the Portal 640 product share of 64%, the charge is $4800.00. Payments received total $3000.00, so all $3000.00 is kept and $1800.00 stays owed.

**Ordered contract, payments above the charge.** The same contract has received a $2800.00 booking deposit and, later, a $2700.00 progress payment, $5500.00 in all. The charge of $4800.00 is kept and the excess of $700.00 is refunded from the most recent payment first: $700.00 against the $2700.00 progress payment, naming it as the source.

**Signed contract.** A Ridgeline Glide 720 Vinyl Sliding Patio Door contract in status signed with $1200.00 received is charged the Glide 720 pre-measure cancellation fee of $175.00; $1025.00 is refunded.
